name: serverkit-vela
description: Create and manage named Vela instances on panel-managed servers. Each instance is a virtual server with its own container, data disk, domain and login, deployed from the official Vela serverkit.yaml recipe as a ServerKit managed app.
author: Juan Denis

walkthroughs.title: Create your first desktop
walkthroughs.description: Deploy a named Vela instance with its own container, data disk and domain, then sign in with the generated password.

steps.title: Open the create form
steps.description: Start a new Vela instance from the Vela page.

steps.title: Name the desktop
steps.description: Pick the target server, give the desktop a name, and optionally set the domain it answers on.

steps.title: Create the desktop
steps.description: Submit the form. ServerKit deploys the container, data disk, domain and a generated first-start password.

steps.title: Open the desktop
steps.description: Open the instance URL and sign in with the generated password from ServerKit's secret vault.
